scope: Thirty-second qualification, declared before any thirty-second run. Existing motor, tracking, balance, and command limits retained.

dimensions: body stance height and foothold centers
search.selection: Actual net travel with tracking, balance, foot lift, and reference bounds; no inverse-planner score is a walking score.

limitations: Reference envelope is authored, not a measured limit.
Sampled clearance is not continuous collision proof.
No physical-unit mapping or calibrated battery/current model.
Every candidate executes the bounded controller inside full Rust simulation; no post hoc filtering of accepted results.
